title: Adic exceptional adjunction and compact-support projection formula
statement:
Let $k$ be any field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $R=\mathcal O_E$, $\varpi$ a uniformizer, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with modules over $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale sites and their derived-complete bounded constructible categories [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and with completed pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], adic direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and compact support [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support].

There are exact $R$-linear constructible adjunctions $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ and $Rf_!\dashv f^!$. The exceptional functor preserves the indicated integral category and has canonical natural reductions
$$(f^!M)\otimes_R^LA_n\cong f_n^!(M\otimes_R^LA_n),$$
where $f_n^!$ is the bounded constructible exceptional adjoint on finite-coefficient etale categories, on the bounded constructible etale complexes of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], transported to the pro-etale site by the exact comparison pullback $\nu_T^*$ along $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The integral counit reduces to the finite counit. For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ and $M\in D^b_c(Y,R)$ the canonical projection map is an isomorphism
$$Rf_!(K\widehat\otimes_R^LLf^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}(Rf_!K)\widehat\otimes_R^LM.$$
For composable separated finite-type maps $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$, the compact-support composition isomorphism $Rg_!Rf_!\cong R(gf)_!$ and its right-adjoint mate $f^!g^!\cong(gf)^!$ hold on these integral categories; they satisfy identity and associativity equations. All these adjunctions, comparisons and projection maps commute with shifts. For a finite extension $E\subset L$ write $C_{L/E}K=K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ for integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. There are natural isomorphisms $C_{L/E}Lf^*\cong Lf^*C_{L/E}$, $C_{L/E}Rf_*\cong Rf_*C_{L/E}$ (adic direct images), $C_{L/E}Rf_!\cong Rf_!C_{L/E}$ and $C_{L/E}f^!\cong f^!C_{L/E}$, the last being the right-adjoint mate of the compact-support one. Each is the identity for $L=E$ and, for $E\subset L\subset L'$, satisfies the tower equation with the composition isomorphisms $C_{L'/L}C_{L/E}\cong C_{L'/E}$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. Under these isomorphisms and the tensor comparison of that lemma, scalar extension carries the units and counits of both adjunctions, the finite reductions, the composition isomorphisms and their mates, and the projection maps over $\mathcal O_E$ to the corresponding ones over $\mathcal O_L$.
